inspection.type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {a : ι → ι → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {s : ι},
  QuarticQuery.Tournament.IsComparison a →
    QuarticQuery.Tournament.UnitValued a →
      0 ≤ ε →
        ε ≤ 1 →
          QuarticQuery.Tournament.Dominant a ε s →
            ∀ {T : ℕ},
              ↑T * ε < 1 / 2 →
                ((QuarticQuery.Tournament.prob a T fun x l => s ∉ l) ≤
                    QuarticQuery.Tournament.prob a T fun w x => 1 / 2 ≤ QuarticQuery.Tournament.total w) ∧
                  (QuarticQuery.Tournament.prob a T fun w x => 1 / 2 ≤ QuarticQuery.Tournament.total w) ≤
                    2 * ↑(Fintype.card ι) / 2 ^ T
